title: The Great Barrier Reef Gets Two Years To Heal
hook: Bleaching now returns long before damaged coral can recover.
closing: Each early bleaching wave resets recovery, trapping the reef in repeated damage.
question: Can the reef recover fast enough?

segments.say: The reef has bleached three times this decade. A rare crisis has become routine.
The average gap between recent bleaching events is two years. Damage now returns before recovery settles.
Coral typically needs 10 years to recover but gets only two. The next wave arrives eight years too soon.
